scope: Routine standoff handoff from stationary combined ground fire
finding: Combined ground roles blocked routine targeting, but GROUND_FIRE had no movement lease, so routine anti-tank standoff could move the support platform while its fire reservation remained active.
change: After the existing standoff trigger and a viable escape proposal, a current stationary GROUND_FIRE role is submitted once per exact snapshot to the existing authenticated OTHER_INTENT_ACTIVE retirement/fallback. Record before RPC. Routine standoff lease/movement requires no captured live ground role; even a synchronous reply defers movement to a subsequent callback. GROUND_MANOEUVRE retains its own operation. Emergency danger/withdrawal paths are unchanged.
integration: Server retires only the exact role then uses existing bounded fallback, preserving original contact/expiry. Requesting retirement issues no native command. Existing group state stores one last snapshot and clears it once no ground role is live; no timer/worker/deadline renewal. If request is not processed, routine standoff remains blocked until original role retirement/expiry; no repeated RPC storm.

validation.packageSource: 3bb5bfa8+dirty unsigned development, not later clean commit

limits: This is routine standoff/support arbitration, not complete emergency-role handback, multi-asset composition or physical tactical acceptance.
commandCommit: Escape geometry remains outside the native command block. An unscheduled commit requires the current public role to equal the captured unassigned/expired snapshot before ownership lease acquisition and movement; a newly arrived role cannot be overridden by a stale no-role observation.
